summaries.name: Cucumber Lime Refresher
summaries.summary: Cucumber Lime Refresher combines tequila, fresh lime juice, cucumber syrup (cucumber slices infused in simple syrup), and a splash of soda water, garnished with a cucumber slice and a lime wheel.

summaries.name: Jalapeño Pineapple Spritz
summaries.summary: Jalapeño Pineapple Spritz mixes tequila, pineapple juice, jalapeño pepper syrup (sliced jalapeños infused in simple syrup), and a splash of lemon-lime soda, garnished with a pineapple wedge and a slice of jalapeño.

summaries.name: Grapefruit Ginger Fizz
summaries.summary: Grapefruit Ginger Fizz combines tequila, grapefruit juice, fresh lime juice, and ginger liqueur, topped with soda water and garnished with a slice of grapefruit and a sprig of rosemary.

summaries.name: Cantaloupe Agua Fresca
summaries.summary: Cantaloupe Agua Fresca blends tequila, cantaloupe puree, fresh lime juice, and a splash of agave syrup, strained over ice and garnished with a cantaloupe ball and a sprig of mint.

summaries.name: Spicy Mango Mule
summaries.summary: Spicy Mango Mule mixes tequila, mango puree, lime juice, ginger beer, and a dash of cayenne pepper, served in a copper mug with a lime wheel and a sprig of mint.

summaries.name: Tequila Sunrise
summaries.summary: Tequila Sunrise is a classic cocktail made with tequila, orange juice, and grenadine, garnished with a slice of orange and a cherry.

summaries.name: El Diablo
summaries.summary: El Diablo is a spicy and smoky cocktail made with tequila, ginger beer, lime juice, and a splash of cassis, garnished with a slice of lime and a sprig of mint.

summaries.name: Cucumber Collins
summaries.summary: Cucumber Collins is a refreshing, light cocktail made with tequila, cucumber puree, lime juice, and a splash of soda water, garnished with a slice of cucumber and a sprig of mint.

summaries.name: Tequila Spritz
summaries.summary: Tequila Spritz is a fruity, bubbly cocktail made with tequila, prosecco, lime juice, and a splash of fruit juice (such as pineapple or grapefruit), garnished with a slice of fruit and a sprig of mint.

summaries.name: Blood Orange Margarita
summaries.summary: Blood Orange Margarita is a twist on the classic margarita made with tequila, blood orange juice, lime juice, and a splash of agave syrup, garnished with a slice of blood orange and a salt rim.
